newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen B shares end lower in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B shares end lower in dull trade.

text.p: Shenzhen's B share index closed slightly lower on Thursday with investors mostly sidelined waiting for more B share firms to release their 1996 annual results, brokers said.
The index lost 1.05 points or 0.65 percent to close at 161.20 points on thin turnover of HK$44.1 million, compared with Wednesday's HK$48.4 million.
"A wait-and-see mood dominated the market and barred fresh money inflow," a trader with J&A Securities (Hong Kong) Ltd said.
"We expect the index to hover in a narrow band above the 160-point support level in the run-up to the end of the annual report season," a trader with China Guotai Securities said.

China's securities regulators have ordered all listed companies to make public their 1996 annual results by April 30, but only four out of 44 Shenzhen-listed B share firms have published 1996 reports so far.

"A buying order of 30,000 shares for Wafangdian Bearing in the last few minutes ahead of the close pushed the issue off its intraday low of HK$5.0 and limited the index's loss," the Guotai trader said.
The index-weighted issue traded the most on volume of 1.43 million shares and ended unchanged at HK$5.03 after hitting a day high of HK$5.15 in early morning.
Shenzhen Tellus Machinery performed worst and slid HK$0.22 or 6.34 percent to HK$3.25 on volume of 126,500 shares.

The A share index rallied 1.22 points or 0.27 percent to close at 458.38 points on a correction after steep rises in the past few weeks, brokers said. Turnover was 7.4 billion yuan compared with Wednesday's 9.6 billion.
